sections.heading: Serving Scottsdale and the surrounding valley.
sections.body:
We cover all of Scottsdale and the surrounding area, including Old Town, McCormick Ranch, and North Scottsdale. For fifteen years we have fitted glide-out shelves into valley kitchens, measuring the cabinet you already own and building to that exact opening.

Every shelf is measured in your home and cut to that opening, so an older Scottsdale kitchen gets the same fit as a new build. Postcodes served include 85251, 85254, and 85260.
